doctrine.title: Spacepower: Doctrine for Space Forces (2020 capstone, superseded by SFDD-1)

entries.title: Assuming the Duties of Chief of Space Operations
themes: Shift from establishing the force to delivering force capabilities
Focus on combat readiness, developing Guardians, and partnerships
Be builders and critical thinkers, not assessors or critics

quotes.text: we need "builders" more than "assessors," and we need critical thinkers more than critics.
we must transition from the establishment of the Force to the delivery of force capabilities.
Our nation is counting on us to deliver…now it's time to deliver.

entries.title: Three Years of Learning
themes: Component field commands present space forces to combatant commands
Three LOEs: combat-ready forces, Guardian Spirit, Partner to Win
Maintain urgency; ruthlessly deprioritize distractions
Form follows function in organizational design

quotes.text: Service components are the primary building blocks of the Joint Force.
Complacency now, in the current strategic environment, would imperil America's orbital advantage.
We must also ruthlessly deprioritize any distractions.

entries.title: Fielding Combat Ready Forces
themes: LOE 1: field resilient, ready, combat-credible forces
Present space forces, not just technology or systems
Fully burdened force design including crews, C2, sustainment, training
Realistic ranges and training devices against a thinking adversary

quotes.text: the Space Force does not present technology, systems, or capabilities to the Joint Force; we present space forces.
A resilient force can withstand, fight through, and recover from attacks.
the Space Force must field combat-ready forces prepared to outcompete rivals, deter aggressors, and defeat enemies.

entries.title: Amplifying the Guardian Spirit
themes: LOE 2: unleash Guardian creativity, innovation, and determination
Principled public servant, space-minded warfighter, bold problem solver
Take care of Guardians via transparent personnel management
Talent and expertise are the key operational advantage

quotes.text: Individuals who embody the Guardian Spirit will thrive in the Space Force; those without it will struggle.
They are primed to seize and exploit the initiative and comfortable empowering subordinates to act.
Guardian talent and expertise is our most important operational advantage.

entries.title: Partnering to Win
themes: LOE 3: strengthen joint, coalition, interagency, academic, commercial partnerships
Partnerships as force multipliers expanding capacity and resiliency
Eliminate barriers like over-classification and incompatible systems
Accelerate LOE-aligned activities; discard those that don't align

quotes.text: Spacepower is a collaborative endeavor.
Partnerships should also act as critical force multipliers and expand our competitive advantage.
Partnering is not transactional.

entries.title: Mission Command
themes: Mission command achieves commander's intent, not task completion
Commanders set what and why; subordinates determine how
Continuous feedback builds shared understanding and rapid initiative

quotes.text: Ultimately, mission command is about achieving the commander's intent, not completing tasks.

entries.title: Barriers to Mission Command
themes: Close the mission command say-do gap
Relinquish control while retaining responsibility for outcomes
Build mutual trust; treat disciplined-initiative mistakes as learning

quotes.text: Mission command requires leaders to relinquish direct control of a task while retaining responsibility for the outcome.

Mission command will thrive if we accept these mistakes as learning opportunities; it will wither if we punish them.

entries.title: The Formative Purpose of the Space Force
themes: Space superiority is the Space Force's formative purpose
Contest and control the space domain for the Joint Force

quotes.text: Our Service was established to contest and, when directed, control the space domain on behalf of the Joint Force.
space superiority - the doctrinal concept for domain control in space - is the formative purpose of the Space Force.
But after three years, I'm past answering why and ready to focus on the how.

entries.title: Inaugural Guardian Field Forum
themes: Direct field feedback to senior leaders drives change
Unleash creativity and innovation at the tactical level
Every Guardian can raise recommendations through the chain of command

quotes.text: Amplifying the Guardian Spirit is all about unleashing the creativity and innovation of our workforce.

themes: Core values: Character, Commitment, Courage, Connection
Handbook as blueprint for living the values

Every Guardian is a Space Force ambassador

entries.title: Biography: General B. Chance Saltzman
entries.summary: 2d CSO; first USSF lieutenant general and first general officer (2020). Boston University 1991 (AFROTC). 29 USAF years: ICBM operator, two NRO tours, Space Weapons Officer, squadron/group/wing command, Deputy CFACC (OIR/OEF/OFS). First DCSO Operations, Cyber and Nuclear. As CSO: Competitive Endurance, IMDs/SYDs, PAEs, Commercial Space Strategy, Allied by Design, SPAFORGEN, Objective Force.

entries.title: 2022-2026: Service Milestones
entries.summary: 2022: first C-FLDCOMs (INDOPAC, CENT, Korea). 2023: three LOEs, Competitive Endurance, mission statement, GFF, PWSA launches, Victus Nox, RED SKIES. 2024: SPAFORGEN, IMDs, SFPMA, Commercial Space Strategy, Six Truths, RAF Air Marshal. 2025: SFDD-1, Midnight Hammer, International Partnership Strategy, AIQT, Vector, SpOC to CFC, 109 Eastern Range launches. 2026: Objective Force 2040, Absolute Resolve, Epic Fury.
